newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma firmer, long depos easier, bonds range.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma firmer, long depos easier, bonds range.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was heading higher in early dealings piercing the 310 level, depos were trading lower five to 10 basis points from one-month to 12-month periods and bonds were idling, dealers said.
"Ecu/drachma is buoyant trading above 310," said a forex trader at a foreign bank. "It kicked off the day at 309.85/95 and risen to 310.20/30 before easing to 310.15/20."
The trader attributed the strengthening of the ecu against the drachma on a firmer mark and possible the lingering effect of some ecu buying for drachmas from Spain late on Friday.
"I think the market is indifferent in opening new positions at this level, 310.20/40," said the trader.
Greek depos were trading five to 10 basis points lower from one-month to 12-month periods and forex forwards were stable, dealers said.
Bonds were little changed digesting Friday's sizeable gains, dealers said.
The central bank said it will cut its discount, Lombard and overdraft rates by 100 basis rates to 14.5 percent, 19 percent and 24 percent effective May 13.
It cited falling inflation and the need to bring them closer to interbank rates for its decision.
Dealers said the market did not react to the announcement.
The mark was quoted at 159.60/70 from Friday's 159.260 fix, the dollar at 268.78/88 drachmas from 270.710 and the ecu at 310.05/15 from 309.780 drachmas.
